# designedbyomar

> Portfolio site for Omar Tavarez, a principal product designer focused on AI workflows, design systems, fintech, healthcare SaaS, and enterprise product strategy. Available for fractional and freelance work.

Site: [https://www.designedbyomar.com/](https://www.designedbyomar.com/)
Contact: [omar@designedbyomar.com](mailto:omar@designedbyomar.com)
Book a call: [30-minute intro call](https://koalendar.com/e/lets-talk-or-omar-tavarez?duration=30&services=HJUDE)

## Primary pages
- [Homepage](https://www.designedbyomar.com/) : background, selected work, contact
- [Selected work](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work) : case-study index
- [About](https://www.designedbyomar.com/about) : background, how he works, and current role
- [Ask](https://www.designedbyomar.com/ask) : questions and answers about Omar's work, background, and how he works — each answer has its own anchor
- [Design system](https://www.designedbyomar.com/design-system) : public brand, token, component, pattern, motion, content, and accessibility reference
- [Privacy policy](https://www.designedbyomar.com/privacy) : data collection and analytics consent details

## Case studies
- [Management Portal](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work/mgmt-portal/) : healthcare SaaS subscription and notification management
- [Posting Assistant](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work/posting-asst/) : AI-assisted insurance payment posting workflow
- [Page Builder 2.0](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work/page-builder/) : no-code restaurant site builder and design system
- [Connect API Payments](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work/connect-api/) : embedded payments widget partners ship under their own brand, plus the developer portal behind it
- [Athena Design System 2.0](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work/athena-ds/) : enterprise design system behind Plastiq's IPO-era brand
- [Plastiq Marketing Site](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work/plastiq-mktg/) : fintech marketing site and conversion flow
- [Critical Communication Tool](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work/disney-cct/) : enterprise broadcast communication workflow
- [Unified Ad Platform](https://www.designedbyomar.com/work/disney-uap/) : consolidating Disney ad-sales brands onto AdVisor without regressing the ESPN baseline

## Working with Omar
- Omar is a full-time Product Designer at Standard Metrics, designing tools for venture investors. He is not looking for a new full-time role.
- He takes on select fractional and freelance work through his independent practice, Designed by Omar.
- Engagement types: product and website audits, design sprints, single design days, fractional product design (monthly capacity), and marketing website builds and support.
- Best fit: complex B2B products with messy data, edge cases, and operational constraints, including AI workflows, fintech and embedded payments, healthcare SaaS, enterprise platforms, and design systems.
- Pricing depends on scope and is shared directly. To start, book a [30-minute intro call](https://koalendar.com/e/lets-talk-or-omar-tavarez?duration=30&services=HJUDE) or email [omar@designedbyomar.com](mailto:omar@designedbyomar.com) with goals, timing, and budget.
